undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Computer Science
undergraduate.accreditation: NCEAC Highest 'W' Category Accreditation & HEC Recognized
undergraduate.overview: The BS Computer Science program provides rigorous foundations in algorithms, software systems, computer architecture, data science, and cloud computing. It prepares students for high-impact software engineering, research, and startup leadership.

academicQualifications: At least 50% overall marks in Intermediate (HSSC) Pre-Engineering, ICS (Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science), or Pre-Medical with Mathematics deficiency course.
A-Levels with Mathematics and at least two other subjects with grade equivalency certificate issued by Inter Board Coordination Commission (IBCC) of at least 50%.
American High School Diploma with Mathematics equivalent to HSSC pre-requisites.
eligibility.testRequirements: ITU Admissions Test (CS Stream) OR valid NTS-NAT (NAT-IE / NAT-ICS) / USAT taken within the last 12 months.

scholarshipsAvailable: Need-Based Financial Aid (up to 100% tuition waiver)
Merit Scholarships (Top 3 positions in cohort receive 50% - 100% tuition concession)

meritFormula.formulaText: Aggregate Merit Score = (Matric % × 0.15) + (Intermediate Part-1 / Total % × 0.35) + (Entry Test Score % × 0.50)

courses.title: CS Elective I (Web Development / Mobile Dev)

undergraduate.name: Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence
undergraduate.accreditation: NCEAC Approved & Aligned with National AI Policy Framework
undergraduate.overview: The BS Artificial Intelligence program at ITU specializes in neural networks, machine learning, computer vision, robotics, natural language processing (NLP), generative AI, and autonomous systems. Students have direct access to GPU computing clusters at ASTP.

academicQualifications: At least 50% overall marks in Intermediate (HSSC) Pre-Engineering, ICS (Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science), or Pre-Medical with Mathematics bridge.
A-Levels with Mathematics and minimum grade equivalency of 50% issued by IBCC.
Strong quantitative and logical reasoning background.
eligibility.testRequirements: ITU Admissions Test (AI & CS Stream) OR valid NTS-NAT (NAT-IE / NAT-ICS) / USAT.

meritFormula.formulaText: Aggregate Merit Score = (Matric % × 0.15) + (Intermediate % × 0.35) + (ITU AI Entrance Test % × 0.50)

applicationProcess: Step 1: Register on the ITU Online Admission Portal (admissions.itu.edu.pk).
Step 2: Fill in academic records (Matric/O-Level and Inter Part-1/A-Level).
Step 3: Generate and pay the application processing challan fee (PKR 2,000) at designated Bank of Punjab (BOP) or online 1Link.
Step 4: Select preferred test date for ITU Entrance Test or submit valid NTS-NAT/USAT roll number.
Step 5: Download Admit Card for the ITU Entrance Exam held at Arfa Software Technology Park.
Step 6: Check merit list announcements on the portal.
documentsRequired: Attested copy of Matric / O-Level result sheet & certificate (with IBCC equivalence).
Attested copy of Intermediate Part-1 / HSSC or A-Level result statement.
3 passport size photographs with blue or white background.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is the fee per credit hour for BSCS and BSAI at ITU?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: For BS Computer Science (BSCS), the tuition fee is PKR 9,200 per credit hour. For BS Artificial Intelligence (BSAI), it is PKR 9,500 per credit hour. A typical semester comprises 16-18 credit hours, making the semester tuition around PKR 156,400 - 166,500 plus semester registration fees.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: What is the merit formula for undergraduate admissions at ITU?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: ITU calculates aggregate merit using: Matric / O-Levels (15%) + Intermediate / A-Levels (35%) + ITU Entrance Test or NTS-NAT (50%). Aggregate = (Matric% * 0.15) + (Inter% * 0.35) + (Test% * 0.50).

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Does ITU offer transport / bus service for students in Lahore?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes! ITU operates 4 comprehensive bus and coaster routes covering Thokar / Canal Road, Shahdara / Mall Road, DHA / Cantt / Walton, and Wapda Town / Johar Town / Township. The transport fee is PKR 28,000 per semester. Additionally, the Lahore Metro Bus stops right in front of Arfa Software Technology Park.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Can Pre-Medical students apply for BS Computer Science or BS AI at ITU?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, per HEC revised guidelines, Pre-Medical students who have achieved at least 50% marks in F.Sc Pre-Medical can apply, provided they pass a 6-credit deficiency mathematics course in their first year of study.

frequentlyAskedQuestions.question: Is ITU recognized by HEC and NCEAC?
frequentlyAskedQuestions.answer: Yes, Information Technology University (ITU) is chartered by the Punjab Government, fully recognized by HEC, and its computing degrees (BSCS and BSAI) carry the highest accreditation tier from the National Computing Education Accreditation Council (NCEAC).
